title: Simple snacks
description: This mod adds new food items that are snacks like chips, popcorns, jelly beans and lollipops
body:
This is a mod that adds snacks and butter
Snacks that the mod adds:
Lollipop
Jelly beans
popcorns
chips
Extra items for crafting:
Butter
![This is the things the mod adds](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6e15bb29e2d443cc0381f97c2aef0532b2e80e68.png)
I have also added an creative tab so you can get all the items in creative
